programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: A series of reports presenting the customs and life situation of women living in distant corners of the globe.Journalist Martyna Wojciechowska once again sets out on risky expeditions to learn about the activities, passions and dreams of women living in different cultures.Stops in the third edition of the program include Samoa, Ghana and India.Together with her interlocutors, she experiences their joys and sorrows and participates in everyday activities.This allows her to understand contrasts and learn about different approaches to femininity in different parts of the world.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska, the heroine of the episode, Nidialys Acosta Cabrera, guides Martyna Wojciechowska around a country where absurdities known to Poles from the times of the Polish People's Republic are commonplace.She is one of the few women driving a taxi in Havana.Her car is also an exception - a pink Chevrolet from the 1950s. Sometimes she changes it to a blue Chevrolet.He chooses the color of nail polish to match the color of the bodywork.Her first and favorite car was a Fiat 126 p - a car still popular on the island.The episode will feature a large dose of Cuban music and humor straight from Bareja's comedy.

programs.title: Aloha, new home
programs.desc: Spouses Kamohai and Tristyn Kalama are native Hawaiians whose passion and mission is to renovate abandoned houses on the island of Oahu.Contrary to appearances, it is not just pleasant work in beautiful natural surroundings.Many of these properties are in a deplorable condition due to moisture, wind and sun.Renovations are additionally complicated by difficult terrain and changeable weather.However, the reward for designers is the end result, which is worth every moment spent renovating these amazing buildings.

programs.title: Manhunt with Joel Lambert
programs.desc: Former Navy SEAL, Joel Lambert, faces an elite reconnaissance unit of the American army.Within two days, he must cover a specific route so as not to get caught.During this unusual mission, he can use the items he has in his backpack and what he finds along the way.Thanks to modern filming techniques, viewers follow the manhunt, both from the point of view of the hunted and the commandos tracking him.The program was shot in the United States, Poland, South Africa, the Philippines, Panama and South Korea.
